children: long.xyz co-founder Nate said the platform will focus over the next few days on building distribution channels that do not rely on public blockchains, the crypto market, or Meta cycles. According to Odaily, he reiterated his view that stock pairs will become the crypto market's "final Meta."

Nate said the market still underestimates the potential of the stock market in terms of narrative, distribution channels, and capital scale. He added that top trading pairs on long.xyz have already begun forming their own narratives and distribution channels, and that the scale could expand 1,000 times if the platform no longer depends only on Crypto Twitter.

He also said long.xyz will not frequently change its product direction because of trends such as AI agents or cat memes, and will continue to focus on stock-related trading pairs rather than rotating its launchpad with shifting market Meta trends.

title: long.xyz Co-Founder Nate Says Stock Pairs Will Be Crypto Market's Final Meta
